title: Romani et al. 2025 — BrainForm: a Serious Game for BCI Training and Data Collection (P300 ERP, University of Trento)
description: This dataset comprises scalp EEG recordings from 22 participants collected using BrainForm, a gamified brain-computer interface designed for P300 event-related potential elicitation via a serious-game speller/selection task. The data support investigation of BCI skill acquisition across repeated sessions and the effects of different visual stimulation textures on P300 performance. Recordings were collected at the University of Trento using consumer-grade hardware and a minimal EEG setup, then converted to BIDS format for reuse.
methods_description: Participants completed repeated runs of a P300 spelling/selection task within a serious game, using consumer EEG hardware and a minimal setup, with a within-subject design involving multiple runs and two task complexities.

funding_references.funder_name: University of Trento and Fondazione Bruno Kessler
